stayType: Camping and Caravanning Club site (touring pitches)
accommodation: Grass pitches with or without electric, hardstanding with electric, jumbo grass pitches, and super service hardstanding with water and drainage. Open 27 Mar-26 Oct 2026.
suitableFor: Tent campers, caravanners, motorhome and van surfers, families, dog owners
confirmedFeatures: Toilets and showers, accessible facilities, dishwashing, motorhome service point, laundry, ice-pack freezing, parent and baby room, shop, Wi-Fi, children's play area, playing field
overview: A Camping and Caravanning Club touring site about three miles from Land's End in the far west of Cornwall, open from late March to late October. It offers grass and hardstanding pitches, including serviced pitches, with a shop, laundry and play area on site.
surfTripFit: Well equipped for van and tent surfers working the Sennen area, though the site page gives no walking distance to the beach and no board facilities.
